open_points.subject: recovery of runs containing both waiting and executable elements
open_points.text: “A run that still waits has only its lagging status and waiting points rewritten, and the advance reaches nothing more of it” contradicts A13 rule 8: “While some elements wait, every other ready node keeps executing within the request.”
open_points.question: During startup recovery, must a run with at least one waiting element still advance its other ready elements before it is allowed to rest?
options: Advance every ready independent element until the run is quiescent, then store its waits and resting status
If any element waits, rewrite the run state without advancing any other element
open_points.default_guess: Advance every ready independent element until quiescent, then persist the resulting waiting points and status.

open_points.subject: order of recovery reaches before run derivation
open_points.text: “deciding each stored waiting point” and “a wait for an approval never requested … is reached again” name no order among multiple waiting points of the same run.
open_points.question: In what order must recovery call `effects.reach_operation_element` when one run has several stored waiting points that require a fresh approval?
options: Order by (`node_id`, `map_index`), with no `map_index` before index 0
Let `run_graph.plan_run` select one at a time
open_points.default_guess: Use (`node_id`, `map_index`) order, with an absent `map_index` before index 0.
